title: Paid Launch Foundation
summary: YTIntel now has the commercial layer needed to move from a powerful creator tool toward a paid SaaS: clear Free and Founding Pro plans, usage limits, premium upgrade UX, conversion tracking and persistent subscription/usage infrastructure.
discord_changes: Added a polished Free vs Founding Pro upgrade experience directly inside YTIntel, built around the Analyse → Packaging workflow.
Added persistent monthly usage tracking and plan-aware limits for deep analyses, Packaging Lab and Opportunity Radar.
Created the live YTIntel Pro product in Stripe at $39 USD/month; checkout activation is waiting on Stripe's required public business-name field.
changes: Added the v0.29 commercial UI with an in-app Unlock Pro control, premium pricing modal, usage status pill and limit-reached upgrade states.
Positioned the free plan at 3 deep analyses, 1 source-specific package run and 5 Radar scans per month so users can reach first value before paying.
Positioned Founding Pro at $39 USD/month with 60 deep analyses, 30 deep package runs and 200 Radar scans per month.
Created live Stripe product prod_VCygL88mhGJJ1o and recurring monthly price price_1UCYjIKCi4Ty31a3z4fouGu1.
Added Supabase subscription-state, monthly-usage and commercial-event tables with RLS plus authenticated status and usage-consumption RPCs.
Added conversion instrumentation for app opens, pricing views, upgrade clicks, action starts, free-limit hits and package-result views.
Added premium value rails to Analyse and Packaging Lab so first-time users can understand the core payoff without learning the whole navigation system.
Bumped the PWA shell to v0.29.0 and added CI syntax checks for the commercial and deep-packaging launch files.
Kept live checkout disabled until Stripe has the required public business name rather than exposing a broken or unverifiable purchase flow.
why_it_matters: The product is no longer missing the commercial experience around its intelligence. Users can understand what is free, what Pro unlocks and when an upgrade is relevant. The remaining launch blocker is payment-account activation and secure post-payment entitlement provisioning, not another creator feature.
